title: Flyering 101: How to nail flyer distribution - Marq

facts.fact: The Marq blog post 'Flyering 101' was published on 2026-03-23.
Marq states that its research identifies six issues to consider before distributing flyers.
facts.quote: According to our research, here are the top six issues to consider before distributing your flyers.

facts.fact: Marq lists four of the most popular flyer distribution methods: hanging flyers in public or community areas, handing them to people directly, keeping a stack in a high-traffic area, and delivering door-to-door or car-to-car.
facts.quote: The most popular methods are: Hanging the flyers in public/community areas. Handing the flyers to people directly.

facts.fact: Marq notes that some specialized flyering agencies offer GPS tracking so clients can watch distribution in real time.
facts.quote: Some even offer GPS tracking so you can watch in real-time.
